name: MLW Northern Heavyweight
epitaph: The fed's own top singles belt, named in its own rules document; a third-party federation's own broadcast bills a wrestler as "Former MLW Northern Champion" (cited, not reproduced, per the canonical-copy rule) -- the held record's only reign attestation, unminted below.

name: MLW Provincial
epitaph: The fed's own secondary singles belt, named in its own rules document; no champion or title match survives in this collection's holdings.

name: MLW Iron Man
epitaph: A singles belt won only via the annual Yukon Eric Memorial Cup tournament and held for one year, named in the fed's own rules document; no champion survives in this collection's holdings (the tournament itself is never attested as having been held).

name: MLW Northern Tag Team
epitaph: The fed's own only tag belt, named in its own rules document and coveted on-camera by the debuting Judgment Night; no champion or title match survives in this collection's holdings.
